description: Ex-Royal Australian Navy Iroquois withdrawn 31 October 1988. Placed on a pole in the car park of the Heathcote Inn Hotel in December 1995, returned to the museum when the hotel changed hands, and mounted in September 1998 on a pole on the south side of the Nowra bridge over the Shoalhaven River. Refurbished in 2002-03 and again in 2013, when it was re-mounted facing north.
